edits.old: Then MSG-P6-003 is declared for the withdrawn-template hold and is returned with the answer, not as an error status
edits.new:
Then MSG-P6-003 is declared for the withdrawn-template hold and is returned with the answer, not as an error status
    Then the withdrawn template is answered as a hold with the notice in state Held and holdReason TEMPLATE_WITHDRAWN, never with an error status; a repeat with the same key replays the first answer (AC5) and a repeat with a different key answers 409

edits.old: Then rwb.decision.DecisionRecorded.v1 is declared on rwb.decision-record.v1 through the local decision-record library with the decision code D7.1 and the rule R-LIT-03
edits.new:
Then rwb.decision.DecisionRecorded.v1 is declared on rwb.decision-record.v1 through the local decision-record library with the decision code D7.1 and the rule R-LIT-03
    Then the D7.1 generation entry carries the template code and version and the merge snapshot reference in inputs_ref, with the ACE data date on the entry; the notice reference and type in actions; the hold reason or refusal message and the freshness message in outcome; and the final-call set GENERATED, HELD and REFUSED as a reference list (ASM-B2-P7-014-1, ASM-B2-P7-014-4); the text of MSG-P7-009 is left to the message catalogue (ASM-B2-P7-014-6)

edits.old: The composite route, its field list, its masking rules and its timeout budget belong to RWB-PLT-N001-CON and are not fixed here.
edits.new: The composite route, its field list, its masking rules and its timeout budget belong to RWB-PLT-N001-CON and are not fixed here. The notice PDF is reached through the documentId of the notice answer on rwb-document; the addressee role and the masked postal address are read from the rwb-source-data fields of the decision panel, and this contract carries neither.
